acceptance: After a mirror passes validation and the freshness check, every other open same-repo auto/results-mirror-* PR on published-results whose develop commit is an ancestor of the mirrored commit is closed with a comment naming the superseding PR
A mirror PR whose develop commit is not an ancestor is left open
A failure to close one PR is a warning and does not fail the run
Workflow tests cover the close step and the ancestor guard; docs/internal/results-phase-2-runbook.md describes the behavior
Merged through the normal PR flow with an oracle success review on the exact head (the workflow is a soundness path); after merge the open stale mirror PRs close on the next develop push

description: sync-results-data-to-published.yml opens one draft auto/results-mirror-<sha> PR per develop push and only closes a PR that fails its own freshness check. Older mirrors that are still valid stay open: on 2026-10-30 eight draft mirror PRs into published-results were open at once (#3694, #3699, #3715, #3716, #3718, #3722, #3723, #3729). Each mirror is a full snapshot of develop against the published-results tip, so a newer mirror contains every change an older one carries. After a mirror passes validation and the freshness check, close every other open same-repository auto/results-mirror-* PR whose develop commit is an ancestor of the commit being mirrored, leaving non-ancestor PRs open. Salvaged from the unpublished local commit c5934511b on fix/corpus-mirror-close-superseded (2026-10-27); that branch had no PR and no tracker item.
